description: This file defines a template class SynchronizeType within the Thunder::Core namespace, which provides synchronization mechanisms for message handling, including locking, signaling, and message evaluation.

classes.name: SynchronizeType
classes.description: A template class providing synchronization primitives for message passing, including load, evaluate, acquire, lock, and unlock functionalities.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a new message against the current response, sets event if successful.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Sets the event and resets the response.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a response message and resets the event.

methods.name: Evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the current response state and sets event if response indicates completion.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the lock with a timeout, returns status.
